The experience

Less performing.
More being here.

You don’t need to arrive knowing what to do with your hands. We’ll make a plan, find good light, and give you space to settle in.

01 /

Start with your story.

Tell me who you’re celebrating, what you have in mind, and when. We’ll work out the kind of session that fits.

02 /

Make room to be you.

We’ll choose a setting and plan the details. During your session, I’ll give you direction and leave room for the moments between poses.

03 /

Keep this chapter close.

Your photographs will be thoughtfully edited into a gallery you can revisit, share, and make part of your everyday life.

Before your session

A little planning.
A lot more ease.

Tell me what you love, what you’re hoping for, and what makes you nervous. We’ll talk about the setting, outfits, who’s coming, and any details that deserve extra care.

Comfort matters. If you need an accessible location, shorter walking distances, breaks, or a quieter setting, let me know as we plan.

What to wear ↗
During your session

Direction when you need it.
Space when you don’t.

We’ll make a mix of composed portraits and natural interactions. There’s time to try an idea, change the angle, take a breath, and notice the things that make your people yours.

worth keeping.
